12 things people normalized
that are actually toxic

1. checking your phone in the
middle of a conversation

2. calling exhaustion
"productivity"

3. bonding only by complaining

4. never being alone
with your thoughts

5. gossip as entertainment

6. jokes that are really
insults

7. saying yes to everything

8. skipping sleep to
look busy

9. posting your whole life
for strangers

10. comparing your pace
to everyone's

12. scrolling until 2am

i swapped it for a book or a
painting before bed.
